source.worktree: Uncommitted implementation; exact tested package and 34-file source overlay retained locally.

componentIntent.boundaryEffects: Opening authenticates metadata and persists authenticated release checkpoints before device selection and acquisition. Cancellation and progress propagate through existing host/file/HTTP adapters. Owned verified range reads and counters stay in Pack loading. Model semantics, application authority, manifest hash checks, providers and publication policy are unchanged.

implemented: Shared metadata verification preserves Pack v2/v3 signature and release-policy rules; public full verification still hashes actual external bytes.
Incompatible devices and disallowed plans perform no artifact reads; authenticated revocations persist without device initialization or downloading weights.
AbortSignal, JSON-owned timeout and metadata limits, and progress flow through metadata, HTTP streams, Node files and the verified artifact store.
Cancellation closes built-in HTTP streams, prevents model creation after cancelled reads, checks monotonic deadlines at loading boundaries and closes programs returned after cancellation.
Original and cleanup failures are both retained; opening listeners detach and successful sessions do not inherit later opening cancellation.
The internal store owns admitted bytes, hashes each unique artifact once and copies only requested ranges. External hash claims remain untrusted.
Observer counters expose source, hashed, copied, retained, peak-retained and returned bytes. Process memory is measured separately.

acceptance.skipBoundary: The existing Gemma NaN regression explicitly skips an absent local model. Passing unit files are not universal physical qualification.
acceptance.networkRegression: Actual loopback HTTP, signed fixture Packs, synthetic GPU/programs. Metadata/weight cancellation and deadlines observe server disconnect and create no model. Corruption, oversize and progress boundaries are exercised.
acceptance.rangeRegression: After owning a 1 MiB Buffer, 100 four-byte reads copy 400 returned bytes, not 100 whole files. Source/output mutation, invalid ranges, closure admission and closed storage are tested.

installedPackage.boundary: Isolated consumer; Electron, embedding and HTTP contract tests use synthetic execution. The separate physical report uses this exact package. No publication or external adoption.

physical.host: Node 22.22.1; webgpu 0.4.0 / Dawn Vulkan; no Doe; physical adapter
physical.scoreAndRankingParity: Exact between direct and HTTP; unchanged declared tolerances against the source reference.
physical.measurementBoundary: Diagnostic only: fresh process and retained files, not controlled cold OS/driver caches. Other workspace CPU work and repository checks overlapped. No incumbent comparison or statistical speed/memory improvement claim. Counters exclude manifest hashing, transport internals and GPU upload; process RSS is not dedicated GPU residency.
physical.qualificationBoundary: One internal AMD/Node reranker tuple, not a browser/Electron rerun, embedding qualification, offline browser restart, held-out search evaluation or second model release.

retainedAdverseEvidence.finding: Package budget rejected five added acquisition/policy files. The shipped closure was audited and ceilings updated to observed contents, not bypassed.
One of 770 files failed because its assertion encoded artifact verification before selection. The assertion now tests the intended order; the complete chain was rerun.
Passing intermediate observation used an earlier package before the monotonic deadline guard. Kept separate from final-package evidence.

custody.availability: Local retained files; no public upload. Provider tarballs retained, model bytes reused from existing bundle, no private keys copied.

remaining: Qualify a provenance-backed embedding model through the installed package; existing local Qwen embedding files do not establish their source revision.
Build shared text/Markdown chunking, indexing, retrieval and reranking logic with embedding identity/invalidation and unseen-query acceptance.
Connect persistent browser Pack storage and retained application files; verify restart offline, interruption, damaged storage, exhaustion and network privacy.
Measure controlled cold/warm loading, GPU upload and total memory against the pinned incumbent before claiming an improvement.
Extend existing onboarding through conversion, physical evaluation, qualification and explicit publication; generate and evaluate actual alternatives.
Obtain voluntary external use and retention across another model release.
